query.kicker.note: Small heading above the page title, in the military style of the War Room (SIGINT)

query.title.note: Page title: search the corpus and query its database

query.search.note: Panel title (a noun): the search box and its results

query.placeholder.text: Elijah, mantle, Horeb, נביא… or a concept: grief over a lost son
query.placeholder.note: Placeholder in the search box: example searches by name, word, Hebrew word or idea. Replace the English examples with what a reader of your language would type; keep the Hebrew word נביא

query.mode.hybrid.note: Search mode chip: words and meaning combined

query.mode.hybrid_help: Words and meaning, fused: names first, then what both find

query.mode.keyword.note: Search mode chip: match exact words

query.mode.keyword_help.note: Tooltip; BM25 is the name of a ranking algorithm, keep it

query.mode.meaning.note: Search mode chip: match by meaning (semantic search)

query.mode.meaning_help: Concepts and paraphrases by embedding similarity, even with no word in common

query.scope.all.note: Search filter chip: every kind of item

query.scope.entities.note: Search filter chip: people, places, groups, objects

query.scope.systems.note: Search filter chip: rituals, customs and supernatural mechanics

query.kind.verse.note: Tag on a search result telling what kind of item it is

query.kind.event.note: Tag on a search result telling what kind of item it is

query.kind.entity.note: Tag on a search result: a person, place, group or object

query.kind.system.note: Tag on a search result: a ritual, custom or supernatural mechanic

query.via.keyword.note: Which search found a result: the word search. Shown as 'keyword + meaning' when both did

query.via.meaning.note: Which search found a result: the search by meaning. Shown as 'keyword + meaning' when both did

query.score.note: Tooltip: the result's ranking score, a decimal number

query.nearest_to.note: Label before an item: the results are the items most similar in meaning to it

query.back_to_search.note: Tooltip on the button that leaves the 'similar items' list

query.search_error.note: Short label in capitals before a search error message

query.similar.note: Small button on a search result: show items similar to this one

query.similar_title: Find items nearest to this one in meaning

query.sql_console.note: Panel title: a box for typing database queries that cannot change data

query.example.events_in_order.text: Events in time order with their place
query.example.events_in_order.note: Description of an example database query; clicking it loads the query

query.example.minchah_to_jezreel.text: Minchah fire to arrival at Jezreel (hours)
query.example.minchah_to_jezreel.note: Description of an example database query: hours from the fire at the evening offering (minchah) on Carmel to the arrival at Jezreel, 1 Kings 18

query.example.states_by_verse.text: Who holds which state, verse by verse
query.example.states_by_verse.note: Description of an example database query: the states of people and things (alive, widowed, king…)

query.example.prophecies.text: Prophecies and how long fulfilment took (days)
query.example.prophecies.note: Description of an example database query

query.example.place_confidence.note: Description of an example database query: how sure each place's map position is

query.example.person_words.text: Words naming a person in 1 Kings 18
query.example.person_words.note: Description of an example database query; write the book name as your language's Bibles do

query.run.note: Button that runs the SQL query; a keyboard shortcut follows it

query.rows.note: Number of rows a database query returned

query.rows_more.note: Number of rows a database query returned when the list was cut off: at least {count}

query.elapsed_ms.note: How long the query took, in milliseconds (abbreviated)

query.sql_error.note: Short label in capitals before a database error message

query.schema.note: Panel title: the database tables and their columns
